notes.title: Big summer update!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!
We are glad to inform you that a major update of the game has been released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249053/bf3f7e5a035aed3f6003e4448d626b25f122f918.png[/img]

Now a number of new features and improvements have been added to the game. The balance has been corrected to make the gameplay even more fun and balanced. Achievements have also been added, which you can unlock by achieving certain results.

If you want to compare your achievements with other players, now you have the opportunity to see your place in the online high score table. The updated interface will make it easier for you to navigate the game and enjoy the gameplay.

It is now possible to personalize your crab with hats that can be purchased in the store. Fixed old bugs and bugs to make the gameplay even smoother and more enjoyable.

Full list of updates:
[list]
[*] Added online high score table: now the players who have achieved the highest scores in the game get into the online high score table, where their name is displayed.

[*] Achievements Added: 10 new achievements have been added that players can unlock when completing certain tasks.

[*] Hats and Shop added: Players can now personalize their crab with various hats that can be purchased in the shop. This adds elements of style and personality to your character, making it even more fun and unique.

[*] New locations added: New tropical locations have been added where players can show their skills, which makes the game more diverse and interesting.

[*] Added mechanics of moving to a level with a key: now players can move to the next level with a special key that can be found in one of the blocks.

[*] New types of blocks: New types of blocks have been added to the game, which add new gameplay elements and increase the difficulty of the game. Each block has its own features and properties.

[*] Updated old graphics: Improvements and updates of old graphics have been made to make the game world more colorful and attractive to players. The new graphics create a more realistic and lively atmosphere, allowing players to dive even deeper into the game.
 
[*] The balance has been corrected: the balance of the gameplay has been improved to make it more comfortable and exciting for players to complete the levels. Now the character has become more balanced, which will allow him to cope with difficulties and achieve high results.

[*] Updated Interface: The game interface has been updated and improved for a more user-friendly and enjoyable player experience. Now the game elements are clearer and more intuitive, which will allow players to focus on the gameplay and enjoy every moment of the game.

[*] Added more scenery: More scenery has been added to spice up the game world and make it more interesting to explore.

[*] Minor bugs and bugs have been fixed.

[/list]

notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!
